key_findings: NCTP reduced carrageenan paw edema with decreased PGE2, COX-2, 5-LOX, IL-6, IL-1β and TNF-α.
NCTP showed analgesic (hot plate, writhing, formalin), antitussive and antipyretic activity in rodents.
